bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears opened their 2026 season with a historic 59-37 rout of the Carolina Panthers, marking the highest-scoring Week 1 game in NFL history and producing the first-ever "scorigami" of the season. The Bears pulled off a wild 59-37 win over the Carolina Panthers, marking the first time in league history that a game has ended with that exact final score, officially becoming the 1,096th unique final score in NFL history.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions kicked off their 2026 season with a dramatic 31-30 OT victory over the New Orleans Saints , though the win came with some costs as Christian Mahogany was ruled out for the rest of the game after suffering a knee injury in the first half, with further tests needed to determine if he'll miss time beyond Week 1 . Beyond the game, Detroit also made notable roster moves by restructuring contracts for Penei Sewell and Amon-Ra St.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers opened the 2026 season with a stunning collapse in Minnesota, blowing a late lead in the third quarter as the Vikings rallied to hand them the loss despite strong performances from Jordan Love, who threw for two touchdowns, and wide receiver Christian Watson, who had 147 yards and two scores. The loss extended Green Bay's losing streak to six games in a row, dating back to last season and including the playoffs, marking the franchise's longest such streak since 1990-91, with the Packers having led by nine points or more in the second half in four of those six games.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: Kyler Murray left his Vikings debut early in the first quarter after suffering a concussion on a hard, penalized hit from Packers safety Javon Bullard, and Carson Wentz replaced an injured Kyler Murray, and the Vikings outscored the Green Bay Packers 29-3 in the second half to rally for a 39-22 victory at U.S. Bank Stadium.
